title: 2-VASS Reachability Algorithm
description: A self-initiated project implementing a reachability algorithm for 2D Vector Addition Systems with States, a PSPACE-complete problem, using Linear Path Schemas and Non-Negative Least Squares to optimize state exploration and improve efficiency.

title: Decentralized Wikipedia
description: A hackathon project developing a decentralized Wikipedia using Solidity smart contracts, IPFS for content storage, Web3.js for blockchain interactions, and The Graph for efficient data indexing and querying.

title: Lossless Compression & Context Autocomplete
description: A course project implementing LZ77, Huffman Encoding, and Run-Length Encoding for efficient lossless compression, along with a context-aware autocomplete system using the KMP string matching algorithm and user text history.

title: Forecasting & Decision Analytics
description: A course project applying combinatorics, probability, and stochastic games for decision analytics, combined with ARIMA and ETS models on real-world time series such as parking and taxi data, achieving strong predictive accuracy and interpretable fare modeling.

title: Algorithmic Crypto Trading
description: A competition project developing algorithmic trading strategies on BTC/ETH using volatility filtering, technical indicators, and historical anomaly analysis, achieving a 6.55 Sharpe ratio, 51.89% win rate, and controlled drawdowns.
